Column.description: Vertical layout of its children (A2UI basic layout).

Text.description: A short assistant message in plain text. Never course content.

ChoiceChips.description: Interview question answered with chips. Use for short categorical answers (tone, audience, assessments); `multiple` allows several chips. The author can also type a custom answer when `allowCustom` is true.

why.description: One sentence on why the question matters for this source

defaultValue.description: Values used by Decide for me

SingleChoice.description: Interview question with one answer from a short list shown as radio cards (e.g. level).

why.description: One sentence on why the question matters for this source

defaultValue.description: Value used by Decide for me

DurationSlider.description: Interview question for the total course length and the lesson length, in minutes.

why.description: One sentence on why the question matters for this source

LanguagePicker.description: Interview question for the course language (ISO 639-1 codes).

why.description: One sentence on why the question matters for this source

options.description: Languages, value is the ISO code

PriceInput.description: Question about the course price: free or paid, and for a paid course an optional price in the site currency. Asked by the builder itself (never chosen by the model); the price can be confirmed or changed in the publish summary.

why.description: One sentence on why the question matters for this source

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code used for the price

ThemePicker.description: Question about the look of the site: one card per theme preset with a live preview, and an optional accent colour that is adjusted when it would fail WCAG AA contrast. Asked by the builder itself, and only to authors who may change the site theme.

why.description: One sentence on why the question matters for this source

presets.description: Theme presets, value is the preset name

DecideForMe.description: Button that fills every open interview question with its default and explains the choices.

SourceCard.description: An uploaded source: file, processing status and its section tree with fragment ids.

CitationChip.description: Amber chip linking an element to the source fragment it comes from.

label.description: Section label shown on the chip, e.g. §2.3 Brewing ratios

OutlineDiff.description: Proposed course outline as a reviewable diff: modules, lessons with learning objectives and citations, added/changed/removed marks, inline objective edits, approve or request changes.

label.description: Section label shown on the chip, e.g. §2.3 Brewing ratios
Section label shown on the chip, e.g. §2.3 Brewing ratios
Section label shown on the chip, e.g. §2.3 Brewing ratios

GenerationProgress.description: Stage timeline, per-lesson status with retry for a failed step, and the running cost.

LessonPreviewCard.description: A generated lesson rendered for review, with citation chips and actions (edit in chat, view sources).

label.description: Section label shown on the chip, e.g. §2.3 Brewing ratios

QuizQuestionCard.description: One quiz question with its answers, the correct ones marked, the explanation and its cited fragment.

label.description: Section label shown on the chip, e.g. §2.3 Brewing ratios

DiffView.description: Before/after of a proposed change to one element, block by block with word-level marks; approve or reject.

elementLabel.description: Element shown to the author, e.g. Lesson 2.1 › Q2

label.description: Section label shown on the chip, e.g. §2.3 Brewing ratios

ApplySummary.description: What applying the blueprint will create, update and delete in the LMS, with warnings; approve to apply.

VersionList.description: Blueprint version history with origin and status; restore any version.

kind.description: outline, content, patch, author, restore, update (a source update)

PublishSummary.description: Everything the author should know before publishing an applied course: where it will live, its price and theme, the numbers, items that block publishing and warnings that must be acknowledged. The Publish button stays disabled while anything blocks, and until warnings are acknowledged.

url.description: Public address of the course page

label.description: Price as shown to the author, e.g. Free or 49.00 USD

suggested.description: The amount is a suggestion the author has not confirmed

adjustedAccent.description: Accent as shown after the contrast adjustment

SourceConnectionCard.description: A source of the course and how it stays in sync: file name and kind, connector (upload, Git, web page), a status pill (up to date, new version, processing, failed, paused), the revision the course reflects against the latest one, when it was last checked, the error if the last check failed, and the actions Check now and Upload a new version. Props come from the API, never from the model.

state.description: Sync state shown as the status pill

syncedRevision.description: Number of the revision the course reflects

lastCheckedAt.description: ISO time of the last check

error.description: Why the last check or import failed

canUpload.description: Show the Upload a new version action

RevisionTimeline.description: Revisions of one source, newest first: number, origin, trigger, time, status and the change counts against the previous one (for example 3 changed, 1 removed, 2 added, 1 moved). The revision the course reflects is marked In your course. One revision can be selected to see its changes.

counts.description: Change counts against the previous revision

href.description: Link that selects the revision (progressive enhancement)

FragmentChange.description: One changed source fragment: the section label, a kind badge (Changed, Moved, Removed, Added), the magnitude and signals as text (for example a number changed), and the old and new text with a word-level diff marked with plus and minus signs, never by colour alone.

magnitude.description: How much changed; trivial is cosmetic

UpdateItem.description: One proposed change to one element of the course after its source changed, for the author to decide on: the element, what kind of proposal it is (update, citation update, removal, no change needed, update by hand, new section in the source), why, the old and new text with word-level marks, citation chips, warnings (possibly unsupported claim, the answer may be wrong or changed), and the controls Accept, Reject, Reset and Ask for changes with a comment field. Conflict and edited-after-analysis states explain what to do. Props come from the update proposal, never from the model.

label.description: Element shown to the author, e.g. Lesson 2.1 › Q2

reason.description: Why the element changes, plain text

sources.description: Source sections behind the change, e.g. Based on §3.2

label.description: Readable field name, e.g. Option B (correct)
Section label shown on the chip, e.g. §2.3 Brewing ratios

citations.description: Fragments the element cites after the change

items.description: Warning from the grounding check, e.g. Possibly unsupported: …

answerCheck.description: The marked answer may now be wrong

answerChanged.description: The correct answer is different after the change

regenerations.description: Times the author asked for changes

maxRegenerations.description: Most times the author may ask for changes

canDecide.description: Decisions are open (the analysis is finished and the proposal is not settled)

canRegenerate.description: Ask for changes is available (AI is enabled)

href.description: Link to the element in the workspace

ImpactSummary.description: What one update proposal touches: how many course elements need a look, how many quiz answers to check, how many new source sections no lesson covers, how many citations are updated automatically, how many lessons are affected, the cost estimate and the cost so far. An optional line on learner impact appears only when the API provides it. Props come from the update proposal, never from the model.

elements.description: Elements that may need an update

uncovered.description: New source sections no lesson covers

learnerImpact.description: Plain-text line on what learners will see; only when provided

StalenessBadge.description: How far a course is behind its sources, as an icon and words: In sync, Stale with the number of days, or Updates dismissed. It can link to the update review.

CostMeter.description: Running AI cost of the session against its budget.

LearnerImpact.description: What an update does for learners, in plain words: how many learners will see the 'updated since you completed it' notice, how many get one extra attempt for a corrected quiz question, how many had completed a lesson that is retired and how many finished the course before a lesson was added, and the reassurance that completion and past scores stay as they are. When learner notices for updated lessons are switched off for the course it says so. After the update is applied the same facts are in the past tense. Props come from the update proposal, never from the model.

applied.description: The update was applied; the sentences are in the past tense

noticesOff.description: Notices about updated, retired and new lessons are switched off for this course

topicUpdated.description: Learners who completed or started a lesson that changed

questionReattempt.description: Learners with an answer to a corrected quiz question

topicRetired.description: Learners who had completed a lesson that is removed

courseExtended.description: Learners who finished the course before a lesson was added

AuditTable.description: The audit trail of a course's sources and updates as a table, newest first: when, what happened, who did it (a person, the system or an agent) and a short summary, with a Details button per row that opens the full record: the source revision, the course versions it moved between, the number of AI calls, the recorded data and the two hashes that chain the entries. Props come from the audit API, never from the model.

emptyText.description: Shown when there are no entries

actorType.description: Who acted: a person, the system or an agent

actor.description: Name of the actor, or System

mono.description: Show in a monospace font (ids and hashes)

details.description: The full record of the entry
